title: Great for ADHD
body:
Great app to motivate yourself to build habits and make changes in your life. 
Only wish that it was available for android aswell. 
Switching phones made me stop using the app for over a year, and while I now use it on my MacBook - it’s really better suited for a phone.

title: The purest habit tracker
body:
Habits shouldn’t clutter your todo app. Let this app be a dedicated space for a better you with just the right features.

Notifications with quick actions to push them forward a couple of minutes. Friendly sound design and graphics makes it a joy to check off your habits. 

Setup your habits on your iPad, fine-tune them on your iPhone and check them off on your Apple Watch.

This app might have an Apple Design Award waiting around the corner.
author: Mikael Sjövind
